argument:
The bear correctly says that diversification and missing evidence do not establish attractive pricing. The bullish case is narrower: positive reported earnings and equity, roughly stable recent debt and no established lasting outage loss provide a basis to investigate resilience rather than presume impairment.

The price remaining above SMA200 is a surviving condition, not confirmation that the nearby lows will hold. I concede capital, credit and tangible-book evidence must precede a confident purchase. This supports a conditional financial-sector candidate; it does not turn a low provider multiple or resolved service incident into an earnings catalyst.
rebuttal_to_previous: Concede capital/credit/valuation evidence is missing; rebut any structural-impairment inference by distinguishing absence of evidence from observed losses.
